description: Make random passwords or passphrases from a secure random source, with an honest strength estimate in bits. Note: a password made this way passes through the AI conversation; for a secret only the user should see, send them to https://freethetools.com/developer/password-generator/ instead. Runs on this device. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

number.description: Passphrase: add a number at the end (default false).

similar.description: Password: allow look-alike characters l, I, O, 0, 1 (default false).

symbols.description: Password: use symbols such as !#$% (default true).

name: generate_password
title: Password Generator
